checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Small copper robot with blue eyes in all frames.
Large clear sunflower in all frames.

must.item: Robot visibly waters sunflower, water reaching plant or soil
must.why: Frame 2 shows water streaming from the can onto the flower and toward the soil.

faults.what: Watering is visible only mid-clip; by the end the can is upright and the water has stopped, so the action isn't sustained.
Camera push-in makes the robot appear large rather than tiny in later frames.
Sunflower does not clearly bend toward the robot as described; the final frame is cropped. The spout is hidden in the later frames.

summary: A good-looking Pixar-style clip of a copper robot watering a sunflower at golden hour, with visible water in the middle; the watering is brief and the push-in loses the tiny-robot scale.
